macros.name: appendixheaderon
macros.doc: \appendixheaderon is a declaration equivalent to the header option.

macros.name: appendixpage
macros.doc: The \appendixpage command puts a heading in the document like a \part heading; in un-chaptered documents the \part heading appears in the ordinary run of the text like a \section heading, but in chaptered documents it is on a page by itself.

macros.name: appendixtitletocon
macros.doc: \appendixtitletocon is a declaration equivalent to the titletoc option.

macros.name: appendixtocon
macros.doc: \appendixtocon is a declaration equivalent to the toc option.

envs.name: subappendices
envs.doc: By default, the ‘subappendices’ are numbered like normal (sub)sections, except that the (sub)section number itself is typeset as an uppercase letter.
